_comment: Standardized color palette for the BCAT1 glioma project figures. Derived from BCAAr_analysis/05_2HIT_LE_heatmap.py. Reuse these hex codes for the corresponding pathways / conditions across all project figures. Keys are the internal signature IDs; 'label' is the display name shown on figures.

genes._comment: Canonical per-gene colors. ColorBrewer Dark2 green/purple pair, matching human_data/figB6_BCAT_simple, figB2, figB3, tabula_muris_OPC_oligo/figM_mouse_BCAT_simple and BCAT1_DepMap_analysis/fig_bcat1_vs_bcat2. Do NOT use the PRGn pair (#008837/#7b3294) for these genes -- #7b3294 is already assigned to the IleuR condition in plasmidsaurusRNAseq/ and to Steroid biosynthesis below.

genotypes._comment: Mouse Bcat1 genotype colors for KO-vs-WT figures (added v1.4 2026-08-13, per Brian). WT = blue, KO = yellow. NOTE: this intentionally differs from conditions.KO (#2166ac, blue) -- for mouse genotype panels use THIS block, not conditions.

isoleucine_dose._comment: Sequential gradient for the isoleucine dose series (added v1.7 2026-08-13, inverted v1.8 per Brian). Anchored on #7b3294, already the IleuR condition color in plasmidsaurusRNAseq/. Darkest tone on the REPLETE dose (416 uM), fading as isoleucine is withdrawn, so colour intensity tracks isoleucine concentration. Ordinal -- use in dose order, do not reassign to unordered groups.

treatments._comment: Drug-treatment pair for TDI-11055 experiments (added v1.6 2026-08-13). Neutral grey vehicle vs saturated magenta drug -- deliberately outside the genotype (blue/yellow), condition (green/orange/red/blue) and cell-line-group (teal/pink) sets so a treatment panel is not mistaken for any of those. Magenta #b5179e is unused elsewhere in the palette.

cell_line_groups._comment: DMG vs non-DMG cell-line panel colors (added v1.5 2026-08-13). Deliberately distinct from the genotype (blue/yellow) and condition (green/orange/red/blue) sets so panel figures don't imply a WT/KO or control/treatment relationship. Okabe-Ito-adjacent, colorblind-safe teal / reddish-purple pair.

highlight_gene.note: gene-label color for emphasized genes (e.g. BCAT1)

subgroup_divider.note: within-block divider, e.g. up- vs down-regulated genes

section_label.note: grey section bracket labels (e.g. METABOLISM / CELL IDENTITY)
